after.title: Thank You
after.text: CONFIRMED · FUNDING PATH You're All Set. Your Call Is Booked. We'll see you then. Here's what to expect. You took the first real step toward getting funded. Check your email for the confirmation and calendar invite. WHAT HAPPENS ON THE CALL 01 A live Google Meet with your funding advisor We go through your business and your file together. No pitch deck, no runaround. 02 We run your soft pull on the call Tri-bureau, and it does not touch your score. 03 You get your exact funding number You leave knowing exactly what you qualify for and the path to get it. BEFORE WE TALK Take the call somewhere quiet where you can share your screen. Have your business basics handy: entity name, time in business, average monthly revenue. Need to move it? Reschedule straight from the confirmation email. YOUR CALENDAR Tuesday, August 18, 2026 at 8:00 PM – 8:30 PM (America/Phoenix) Add to Google Calendar Apple / Outlook (.ics) COMMON QUESTIONS Is Fundhub a lender? What makes Fundhub different? Will this affect my credit score? Do I need a business to qualify? What if my credit isn't great? What does this cost? Do I have to go done-for-you? Can I make money referring people to Fundhub? How fast does funding move? We'll see you soon.
